exposure: Trial of labor after a single prior low transverse cesarean delivery
trial of labor (TOL) after a single prior low transverse cesarean delivery
cohort: Women at 37 weeks of pregnancy or more with cephalic presentation who were willing to attempt a trial of labor (TOL) after a single prior low transverse cesarean delivery
finding: The close-to-delivery prediction model of Grobman et al. was found to be applicable to Middle Eastern women and might predict VBAC success rates.
